title: Comment test is denied despite passing local checks
root_cause: The job token is limited to issues read, while posting a comment requires issues write. The API returns a 403; the deprecation warnings concern separate passing checks and do not cause the failure.

relevant_evidence.why: The API denial identifies the integration permission failure.
The later warning summary concerns the passing slug checks.
The token has issues read rather than write.
The failing test posts an issue comment using the token.
